name: English
title: Safe Zone Pro — Safe Zone Overlay Plugin for Premiere Pro (Reels, Shorts, TikTok)
description: Free Premiere Pro plugin that adds a safe zone overlay for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and TikTok to your timeline in one click. Keep captions, faces and CTAs out of the UI.
lead: You're cutting vertical Shorts/Reels — and the platform's UI covers up your picture.
body: Safe Zone Pro drops a safe zone overlay straight onto your timeline as its own layer. One click — zone's on. One more — gone before export.
features: Add or remove the zone in one click
Lives on its own track — your sequence stays untouched
Hit Remove — the overlay is deleted from both the sequence and the project
alt: Safe Zone Pro inside the Premiere Pro interface with a vertical video safe zone overlay on the timeline
video_title: Safe Zone Pro demo: adding and removing a safe zone overlay in Premiere Pro
footer: Adobe and Premiere Pro are trademarks of Adobe Inc.
install_note: Premiere will pop a warning that the plugin isn't from the Marketplace. Totally fine — hit continue.
